accountInformation.subheading: The identity details visible across your workspace.

security.heading: Security
security.subheading: Session and sign-in activity for this account.
security.signOutDescription: Ends your current session and returns you to the login screen.

changePassword.rowDescription: Update the password you use to sign in.
changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.description: Enter your current password and choose a new one. You'll stay signed in on this device.
changePassword.cancelTooltip: Discard changes and close this dialog

yourData.heading: Your Data
yourData.subheading: A copy of the personal data we hold about you.

download.title: Download my data
download.description: A zip with a readable PDF summary, the complete record in a data file, and the files you uploaded. Cases and documents that belong to an organization you don't own are not included.
download.confirmDescription: We'll prepare a zip with a PDF summary of what we hold about you, the complete record, and the files you uploaded. It can take a minute for larger accounts. Keep this tab open until the download starts.
download.passwordHint: Enter the password you use to sign in. This keeps your data private if someone else has your device.

dangerZone.heading: Danger Zone
dangerZone.subheading: Irreversible and destructive actions for this account.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Schedules your account for deletion and signs you out. You can restore it by signing in again within 30 days. After that, your account and all associated data are permanently deleted.
deleteAccount.confirmDescription: Your account will be scheduled for deletion and you'll be signed out on every device. You can restore it by signing in again within 30 days. After that, your account and all associated data are permanently deleted and this cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.passwordHint: Enter the password you use to sign in to confirm this deletion.
deleteAccount.scheduledDescription: Your account and all associated data will be permanently deleted on {{date}}.
deleteAccount.successDescription: Your account and all associated data will be permanently deleted on {{date}}. You've been signed out. To restore your account, just sign in again before then.

avatar.wrongType: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.

googleCalendar.title: Google Calendar
googleCalendar.connectedDescription: Connected. Appointments sync both ways: changes here show in Google Calendar, and title, time and note edits made there come back within a few minutes.
googleCalendar.disconnectedDescription: Connect a Google account to sync your appointments with its Google Calendar, both ways. This doesn't change how you sign in.
googleCalendar.popupError: Google didn't complete the connection. Please try again.
